digest.component_or_area: review-bot test fixtures and lifespan configuration
propositions: TestClient entry into review-bot ASGI lifespan inherits production 1200-second shutdown drain by default, causing tests to hang or run long-running background tasks unintentionally.
Unit tests must receive a bounded SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1.0 baseline and stubbed reconciler/janitor background work by default, with explicit opt-in markers to run real reconciliation.

Module autouse fixtures in tests/conftest.py and tests/unit/test_review_bot.py replace the production reconcile_loop and snapshot janitor stubs while bounding the shutdown drain to 1.0 seconds per test.
Production default of 1200 seconds in config.py remains unchanged; test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS environment overrides must take precedence over the test suite baseline.
